title: Enroll in E-Verify and verify new hires (Georgia)
authority: Georgia employment eligibility law / U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services
description: Georgia requires private employers with more than ten employees (counting those working 35 or more hours a week) to use E-Verify for new hires; sources differ on the cutoff (more than 10 or 11 or more).

appliesWhen.description: 11 or more employees in the state
